upcoming_events.title: Alys Beach Crafted
upcoming_events.description: Four days of culinary events at Alys Beach: a wine dinner Wednesday, the Firkin Fête in Central Park Friday 6:30–9 PM, and the Spirited Soirée cocktail tasting Saturday 1–4 PM, with additional craft and market events to be announced · 15-min drive east.

upcoming_events.title: Rosemary Beach Uncorked
upcoming_events.description: Saturday Nov 14, 2026, 1–4 PM · wines poured by vintners from around the world alongside dishes from Rosemary Beach restaurants, with live music as you stroll the cobblestone streets · 15-min drive east

upcoming_events.title: 30A 10K Thanksgiving Day Races
upcoming_events.description: Thanksgiving-morning 10K, 5K and 1-mile fun run through Rosemary Beach — 10K starts 7:30 AM, 1-mile 7:35 AM, 5K 9:30 AM · packet pickup Tue Nov 24 at The Big Chill, no race-day pickup · advance registration only, closes Nov 24 · 15-min drive east

upcoming_events.title: Turn On The Town
upcoming_events.description: Saturday Nov 28, 2026 — the holiday parade steps off from Seagrove Plaza at 3 PM and runs to Central Square, with the town tree lighting around 5 PM in the Amphitheater · free to attend · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: 30A Songwriters Festival
upcoming_events.description: 18th annual · MLK weekend · songwriters across 30A's intimate listening rooms in Seaside, Rosemary, Alys, WaterColor, Grayton and more, with headliners including St. Paul & The Broken Bones and Gillian Welch & David Rawlings · benefits the Cultural Arts Alliance · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Sounds of Seaside Concert Series
upcoming_events.description: Through Dec 30 · Wed 4–6 PM · Free Wednesday-evening concerts on the Seaside Amphitheater lawn, 4–6 PM, running weekly through Dec 30 · a different act each week, free and open to all ages · bring blankets and chairs, snacks and drinks welcome · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Seaside Farmers Market
upcoming_events.description: Year-Round · Sat 9–1 · Saturdays year-round, 9 AM–1 PM at the Seaside Amphitheater, with a second Tuesday market added each June and July · local growers, artisan cheeses and breads, craft chefs, and live acoustic music · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: 30A Farmers' Market
upcoming_events.description: Year-Round · Sun 9–1 · About 30 vendors on Barrett Square every Sunday, 9 AM–1 PM — local produce and micro-greens, Gulf seafood off the boat, artisan breads and sweets, grass-fed beef, tupelo honey · pet-friendly · a great Sunday-morning outing · 15-min drive east

copy.instagram:
Christmas Eve through Dec 26 — both cottages, still open.

Six bedrooms, four baths, sixteen people at one address on Crystal Court.

Two fireplaces going, the Gulf a three-minute walk across the road.

Book direct, link in bio.

New Year's Eve into Jan 2 — Golden Sun is open, 3 nights.

Pelayo public beach access is a three-minute walk straight across Scenic 30A.
